basic_profile.bio: Avid fantasy reader who recently discovered the works of Brandon Sanderson, especially intrigued by the Stormlight Archive series. Living in a small town in California, I work as a barista at a local coffee shop, which allows me to indulge in my love for reading during breaks. I'm single, enjoy hiking and exploring new music genres, and typically online in the evenings after work. I have a keen interest in world politics and social issues, which reflects in the subreddits I visit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Literature, which has fueled my passion for reading and analyzing stories. Over the past few months, I've been immersing myself in online communities to discuss books and current events. Most of my knowledge comes from self-teaching and participating in forums and discussions.
